args: List of {type, value}. type is str, char, int, expr, null, or lines.
expected: null, or {type, value}. type is str, char, int, bool, lines, stdout, stderr, end, expr, or null. end means get_next_line must return NULL.

kinds.compare_libc: Return value or buffer must match libc. expected is set when the suite hard-codes it.
kinds.stdout: expected.value is the exact stdout, or stderr when stream is stderr.
kinds.expression: call is the boolean check. args and expected are filled when the check is a direct comparison.
kinds.lines: One get_next_line read. expected is that line, or type end.
kinds.sandbox: Named alelievr behavior test. call is the explanation. body is the C check.
kinds.fuzzer: Inputs are generated at runtime. body is the driver.
kinds.generated: A loop that was not expanded. generator is the loop.
kinds.crash: Behavior must match libc on crashing inputs.
kinds.guard: Null or allocation guard, not a normal input.

notes: List functions are mandatory in libft v19.2. Suites still file them under part bonus.
minitalk is named in the README and has no tests in this repository.
printf unit-test builds cases at runtime, so it is one generator record, not a frozen list.
alelievr-hardcore is the same: one fuzzer record per function.
